name: Camping zur Mühle
beschreibung: Camping zur Mühle is set in an idyllic rural setting in Tyrol, named after a historic mill on the grounds. The campsite offers pitches for motorhomes and tents in a close-to-nature atmosphere. Amenities include clean sanitary facilities as well as a fresh water and waste disposal station. From here, guests can embark on delightful hikes into the surrounding mountains. The site is perfectly suited for nature lovers and those seeking peaceful relaxation. A small playground is also available for families.
